summary.text: Angela Witwer is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 76 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists her House service as beginning in 2019.
A business owner and former health-system employee, she chaired the House Appropriations Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Witwer was born in Traverse City, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwood University.
Her career includes co-owning and operating Edge Partnerships and working with Sparrow Health System, and she served on the Waverly Community Schools Board of Education.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations with organizations including the American Cancer Society, the Boys and Girls Club, the McLaren Greater Lansing Foundation and the Wharton Center for Performing Arts.

In the 2025-2026 session Witwer is minority vice chair of the Rules and Competitiveness Committee and serves on the Health Policy and Regulatory Reform committees and a select committee on protecting Michigan employees and small businesses.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Bill Kaiser in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Witwer listed improving the education system, protecting senior citizens and a fair tax system as her key campaign messages.
